The '''2025–26 season''' was the [[List of Chelsea F.C. seasons|120th season]] in the history of [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea Football Club]], and their 34th consecutive season in [[Football in England|Premier League]] as well as their 37th consecutive season in the English top flight. In addition to the [[2025–26 Premier League|domestic league]], the club participated in the [[2025–26 FA Cup|FA Cup]], the [[2025–26 EFL Cup|EFL Cup]] and the [[2025–26 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]], returning to the latter competition for the first time since the [[2022–23 Chelsea F.C. season|2022–23 season]].

===FA Cup===
{{main|2025–26 FA Cup}}

As a Premier League club, Chelsea entered the competition in the third round, and were drawn away to [[Charlton Athletic F.C.|Charlton Athletic]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Chelsea discover FA Cup third round opponents |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/chelsea-discover-fa-cup-third-round-opponents-2526 |access-date=8 December 2025 |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=8 December 2025}}</ref> They were then drawn away to [[Hull City A.F.C.|Hull City]] in the fourth round,<ref>{{cite news |title=Chelsea discover FA Cup fourth round opponents |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/chelsea-discover-fa-cup-fourth-round-opponents |access-date=13 January 2026 |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=12 January 2026}}</ref> away to [[Wrexham A.F.C.|Wrexham]] in the fifth round,<ref>{{cite news |title=Chelsea discover FA Cup fifth round opponents |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/chelsea-discover-fa-cup-fifth-round-opponents |access-date=16 February 2026 |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=16 February 2026}}</ref> and at home to [[Port Vale F.C.|Port Vale]] in the quarter-finals.<ref>{{cite news |title=Chelsea discover FA Cup quarter-final opponents |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/chelsea-discover-fa-cup-quarter-final-opponents-march-2026 |access-date=9 March 2026 |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=9 March 2026}}</ref> Chelsea faced [[Leeds United F.C.|Leeds United]] in the semi-finals at [[Wembley]],<ref>{{cite news |title=Chelsea discover FA Cup semi-final opponents |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/chelsea-discover-fa-cup-semi-final-opponents|access-date=5 April 2026 |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=5 April 2026}}</ref> and played [[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]] in the [[2026 FA Cup final|final]], ultimately losing 1–0.

===EFL Cup===
{{main|2025–26 EFL Cup}}

As one of the Premier League clubs competing in a European competition, Chelsea entered the competition in the third round, and were drawn away to [[EFL League One|League One]] club [[Lincoln City F.C.|Lincoln City]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Chelsea discover Carabao Cup third round opponents |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/chelsea-discover-carabao-cup-third-round-opponents [[Wolverhampton Wanderers F.C.|Wolverhampton Wanderers]] in the fourth round,<ref>{{cite news |title=Chelsea discover Carabao Cup fourth round opponents |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/chelsea-discover-carabao-cup-fourth-round-opponents-2025 |access-date=24 September 2025 |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=24 September 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Date set for Chelsea's Carabao Cup trip to Wolves |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/date-set-for-chelseas-carabao-cup-trip-to-wolves |access-date=29 September 2025 |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=29 September 2025}}</ref> and away to [[Cardiff City F.C.|Cardiff City]] in the quarter-finals.<ref>{{cite news |title=Chelsea discover Carabao Cup quarter-final opponents |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/chelsea-discover-carabao-cup-quarter-final-opponent-2025-26 |access-date=31 October 2025 |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=30 October away.<ref>{{cite news |title=Chelsea discover Carabao Cup semi-final opponents |url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/chelsea-discover-carabao-cup-semi-final-opponents |access-date=18 December
